messages.subject: International Executive Profile | Energy, Infrastructure, ESG & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Phipps Cameron Team,

I am introducing my profile for senior international mandates where energy, infrastructure growth and stakeholder strategy intersect. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, strategic partnerships and executive communications.

I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional appointments across resources, energy, infrastructure, ESG and external affairs. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate assignments across the GCC and wider global markets.

My executive CV is attached for confidential review.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
